_how: Event-log digests of the pinned runs (tests/test_sim.gd GOLDEN_RUNS). The Windows tests and the Linux demo (tests/run_sim.gd --golden) must both reproduce them: the same seed gives the same history on every machine. 'memory off' runs are Pilot 1's histories, pinned before memory existed and unchanged by Pilot 2; 'memory on' runs are Pilot 2's, pinned from the Windows run of commit 8d67289. A deliberate change to the simulation's rules changes them; update them in the same commit and say why.
